# Acme — Requirements

**Answers:** what is being built, for whom, why, and how success is judged.
**Look elsewhere for:** screens and visual rules ([ux](ux.md)), how it works
([tdd](tdd.md)), when it ships ([roadmap](roadmap.md)).

## Summary

Households lose track of shared spending because every account lives in a
different bank app. Acme imports statements from each bank into one ledger
that every household member can read. It succeeds when a household reviews a
month of spending in under ten minutes.

## Problem

Household members reconcile spending by hand from several bank apps.

## Users

- **Household member:** imports statements and reviews spending.

## Goals and metrics

- A household reviews a month of spending in under ten minutes (proposed).

## Scope

In: statement import and review. Out: payments, because they need a licence.

## Requirements

<a id="r-core-01"></a>
### R-CORE-01 — Members can import a bank statement

- **Priority:** must
- **Status:** accepted
- **Users:** household member

Acceptance criteria:

1. Given a CSV export from a supported bank, the member sees every
   transaction within ten seconds.

<a id="r-core-02"></a>
### R-CORE-02 — Members can review spending by category

- **Priority:** must
- **Status:** accepted

Acceptance criteria:

1. Every imported transaction has a category the member can change.

<a id="r-share-01"></a>
### R-SHARE-01 — Members can invite another household member

- **Priority:** should
- **Status:** proposed
